arguments.rationale: The agent's changes to the __repr__ method replaced `default={self.default!r}` with `default={self.dump_default!r}` and `missing={self.missing}` with `missing={self.load_default}`, but the existing test `test_repr` passes `default=default` (the old keyword) and expects the repr to show that value under the key `default=`, which now shows `dump_default`'s value instead — a skill gap in not preserving backward-compatible repr output.
